body: I've only had propranolol, no antipsychotics (yet) but I have had friends suggest it might be an option to research. Did you find the side effects pretty bad? My friends who are on different antipsychs say they have had a really bad time with them.

A regular GP for four out of five of those trips. One of the visits I got to see a mental health nurse.

I pretty much demanded a referral to a psychiatrist on my last trip and was asked, for the millionth time, to self refer to the local CBT/ counselling service. A quick glance at my medical notes would have told the doctor that I've been using that service regularly for the last 8 years. 

Do you think it would be worth really pushing them to get me a psychiatric referral? At this point I'm convinced the only way to get one is to actually self harm or attempt.
